notes:
Summary: Inspector Codex builds a GitHub-style PR assistant that summarizes diffs, suggests review comments, and provides ranked comment alternatives for maintainers. Primary objectives: very low end-to-end latency for in-IDE streaming suggestions, deterministic/ pin-able model versions for reproducible reviews, and reranking to present high-quality comment candidates.

Recent talk highlights: 
- CTO (R. Patel): "We need deterministic assists across releases — model pinning non-negotiable."
- Head of Eng: wants streaming token-by-token in VS Code plugin; latency budget 150ms tail for short comments, 300ms for multi-line suggestions.

Security & policies: currently must pass infosec questionnaire (SAML SSO + audit log retention), prefer KMS-backed keys and EU residency option for select customers. Retention policy requested: configurable 30/90/365 days.

Cost posture: mid-market startup; cost sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit-costs drop 30% vs hosted. Interested in Optimize recommendations (batching, KV cache) for peak CI runs.

Integrations: GitHub Apps (checks API), CI (CircleCI/GitHub Actions), in-IDE extension (VS Code), and internal change-tracking service. POC plan: run PR-review assistant against last 100 merged PRs and measure precision/recall of suggested comments + latency under simulated dev load.

Quote from security lead: "We need audit trails and clear data residency guarantees before any private keys are uploaded."

short_summary: Mid-market devtools company building an integrated PR-review assistant. Evaluating Redwood for low-latency streaming, model version pinning, reranking, and VPC-backed deployments. Security sign-off and latency verification are the main gating items.
deal_notes: Interested in hosted API to start, but requires VPC/dedicated for enterprise customers. Asking for a pricing scenario: 2 reserved instances for CI peaks + on-demand for burst. Wants Optimize runbook for batching and cache settings. AE to propose sample contract with X% committed discount.
technical_requirements:
- Streaming API with token-level progress for IDE UX
- Model pinning and stable model hashes per environment
- Reranking endpoint to supply top-3 comment variants with confidence scores
- Support for KV / prefix caching to speed up repeated context across PRs
- SLOs: median <100ms for single-line recommendations, p95 <350ms for multi-line suggestions
- Audit logs and KMS integration
